## Flights and meals

The itinerary includes flights from Mexico City to Mérida, Cancún to Belize City, Flores to Guatemala City, San Salvador to Managua, Managua to San José, and San José to Panama City. International and domestic flights are listed as excluded, although the hotel package line reads “BB + Services + flights”. Ticket prices and whether flights are included need to be agreed separately.

Accommodation is listed on a bed-and-breakfast basis. Day 20 mentions a light snack by the river, and day 25 includes a traditional lunch in an Emberá village. The day 22 outing begins after lunch, with no detailed meal arrangements listed for the lodge. Any other food and drinks that are absent from the itinerary are paid for separately.

## Itinerary conditions

The guide conducts the tours in English. Access to the palace in Mexico City, the terraces of León Cathedral, natural sites and individual venues is confirmed for the travel dates. The hike up Pacaya and the El Tigre trail require a suitable level of fitness. Bird and wildlife sightings depend on natural conditions.

The Green Turtle Museum in Tortuguero is optional, with arrangements to be confirmed. The international departure time from Panama is coordinated with the six-hour tour on the final day.
